limitations: Two identical scalar quadratics, correlated half-dropout compressors with iid rounds, fixed memory and step parameters, zero initial memory; no claim about general-dimensional or almost-sure convergence.
scientific_integrity: All displayed equalities arise from the stated exchangeable covariance recursion, exact symbolic algebra, and the cited Schur criterion. The finite verifier is corroborative, not an exhaustive proof.
title: A sharp two-worker DIANA stability boundary under correlated half-dropout compression
